scope: Publicly discoverable Clojure-family projects, including historical and incomplete attempts; not a claim of universal completeness.

projects.name: Bara Lang
projects.notes: Self-described Clojure for Nim; GitLab repository archived, Codeberg continuation needs checking.

projects.name: Basilisp
projects.notes: Clojure-compatible dialect with Python interop.

projects.name: Calcit
projects.notes: Self-described ClojureScript dialect with indentation-based Cirru syntax; now has extensive typed features.

projects.name: Cherry
projects.notes: Alternative ClojureScript compiler with persistent CLJS data structures.

projects.name: CLClojure
projects.notes: Experimental Clojure port, distinct from Cloture.

projects.name: Cljam
projects.notes: Clojure interpreter with tree-walker and VM; author says complete and not actively maintained.

projects.name: Cljbang
projects.notes: clj!: compiles and evaluates Clojure forms in Emacs.

projects.name: cljgo
projects.notes: muthuishere/cljgo: compiler emitting Go plus interpreted REPL.

projects.name: cljrs
projects.notes: tytrdev/cljrs: independent implementation, not ClojureRS or csm/clojurust.

projects.name: cljs2go
projects.notes: Alternative ClojureScript backend implemented as an overlay; old CLJS baseline.

projects.name: Cloje
projects.notes: Clojure clone layered on Scheme; small subset, documented CHICKEN and Racket support.

projects.name: Clojerl
projects.notes: Clojure implementation for the Erlang VM.

projects.name: Clojure
projects.notes: Reference implementation; CLI or Java entry point.

projects.name: clojure-clr-next
projects.notes: New ClojureCLR implementation under development; keep distinct from released ClojureCLR.

projects.name: clojure-objc
projects.notes: Clojure compiler targeting Objective-C runtimes; historical toolchain.

projects.name: clojure-py (2026)
projects.notes: New clojure-py implementation attempt; package manifest differs from repository's PyO3 description; entry point unverified.

projects.name: clojure-py (historical; drewr fork)
projects.notes: Historical clojure-py, preserved in drewr fork; original halgari link unavailable.

projects.name: clojure-rt
projects.notes: Clojure Real Time compiler; README describes bootstrap phase.

projects.name: clojure-scheme
projects.notes: ClojureScript-derived Scheme backend; explicitly unmaintained.

projects.name: ClojureC
projects.notes: ClojureScript-derived C compiler; explicitly no longer actively maintained.

projects.name: ClojureCLR
projects.notes: Official Clojure implementation on the CLR.

projects.name: ClojureDart
projects.notes: Clojure dialect compiling to Dart; console hello need not use Flutter.

projects.name: ClojureElisp
projects.notes: ClojureElisp: separate compiler from Cljbang; .cljel source files.

projects.name: ClojureFnl
projects.notes: Clojure-to-Fennel proof of concept targeting Lua; .cljf sources; semantics-preserving goals with incomplete compatibility.

projects.name: ClojureHaxe
projects.notes: Experimental Clojure port; README says compiler/core loading work remains.

projects.name: ClojureRS
projects.notes: clojure-rs/ClojureRS: interpreter project; distinct from other Rust ports.

projects.name: ClojureRust (chimez)
projects.notes: chimez/clojure-rust: Clojure-to-Rust source compiler.

projects.name: ClojureScript
projects.notes: Official Clojure-to-JavaScript compiler; browser and server targets.

projects.name: Clojurescript-Lua
projects.notes: ClojureScript compiler with Lua backend; alpha.

projects.name: ClojureScript-Terra
projects.notes: Experimental ClojureScript backend; earlier design name CLIC.

projects.name: ClojureWasm
projects.notes: Independent Clojure runtime; current README explicitly says no longer maintained.

projects.name: ClojuRS (naomijub)
projects.notes: naomijub/ClojuRS: separate Clojure experiment; sparse documentation.

projects.name: ClojuRust (clojurust)
projects.notes: clojurust/clojurust: separate proof-of-concept implementation.

projects.name: clojurust (csm)
projects.notes: csm/clojurust: Rust-hosted Clojure dialect with JIT and AOT.

projects.name: Cloture
projects.notes: Clojure implementation interoperating with Common Lisp; pre-alpha.

projects.name: Cormorant
projects.notes: Clojure dialect interpreter; formerly Lambdatron / Swift Lambdatron.

projects.name: Ferret
projects.notes: Clojure-family embedded language compiling to standalone C++.

projects.name: FOL
projects.notes: Self-described Clojure dialect with CLOS-style objects and array programming; substantially extended semantics.

projects.name: Glojure (glojurelang)
projects.notes: glojurelang/Glojure: hosted Clojure with Go interop.

projects.name: Glojure (venantius)
projects.notes: venantius/Glojure: separate historical compiler; explicitly incomplete.

projects.name: go-joker
projects.notes: rcarmo/go-joker: independently developed fork of Joker for an agent runtime.

projects.name: Gojure
projects.notes: tcard/gojure: historical Clojure-to-Go compiler.

projects.name: Hammock
projects.notes: Partial pure-Ruby Clojure implementation; proof of concept.

projects.name: jank
projects.notes: Native Clojure dialect with C++ interop.

projects.name: JO Clojure
projects.notes: JO Clojure: Clojure-like implementation intended for embedding.

projects.name: Joker
projects.notes: Clojure subset interpreter with linter and formatter; documented CLI.

projects.name: Jolt
projects.notes: Self-hosted Clojure implementation; current host is Scheme, not its original Janet host.

projects.name: Kalai
projects.notes: Restricted Clojure source-to-source compiler; backend-specific build required.

projects.name: Kiso
projects.notes: Independent ClojureScript-to-JavaScript compiler. GitHub repository is archived.

projects.name: Las3r
projects.notes: Clojure-based Lisp compiler for AVM2; historical Flash environment required.

projects.name: let-go
projects.notes: Clojure dialect with interpreter, compiler and Go interop.

projects.name: Lingy
projects.notes: Clojure implementation for Perl; other host directories represent porting work, not verified runtimes.

projects.name: Lokke
projects.notes: Experimental Clojure dialect for Guile.

projects.name: mino
projects.notes: Embeddable Lisp participating in Clojure conformance comparison; include as partial implementation.

projects.name: nanoclj
projects.notes: Tiny Clojure interpreter intended for embedding.

projects.name: Rouge
projects.notes: Rouge: Clojure-based Ruby Lisp; historical source-run REPL.

projects.name: Rustly
projects.notes: Clojure-to-Rust transpiler; hello-world build example documented.

projects.name: SCI
projects.notes: Small Clojure Interpreter; library embedding is a valid hello-world route.

projects.name: Squint
projects.notes: ClojureScript dialect using JavaScript data structures.

projects.name: Swish
projects.notes: Embeddable/compiler implementation; author now describes it as full-blown Clojure, started with Claude Code.

projects.name: TimL
projects.notes: Clojure-like API and compiler for Vim; editor-hosted example.

projects.name: Torque
projects.notes: Torque compiler; documentation provides Docker build and native REPL.

projects.name: Zera-5
projects.notes: Experimental lightweight Clojure implementation.

projects.name: Arcadia
projects.notes: Unity integration; formerly clojure-unity.

projects.name: Babashka
projects.notes: Native scripting interpreter built with GraalVM; does not require a JVM at execution time.

projects.name: Choq
projects.notes: Choq packages Cherry inside QuickJS; experimental standalone runtime.

projects.name: Closh
projects.notes: Closh shell environment; author declared hiatus in 2022.

projects.name: Cream
projects.notes: Experimental runtime for full JVM Clojure using a custom Clojure fork.

projects.name: Esprit
projects.notes: ClojureScript runtime support for embedded hardware.

projects.name: Gloat
projects.notes: Glojure Automation Tool; compile/run Clojure or YAMLScript using Glojure.

projects.name: Glojure (Gloat fork)
projects.notes: Temporary implementation fork supporting Gloat; same language family as upstream Glojure.

projects.name: Goby
projects.notes: ClojureScript and Objective-C integration, not a new language.

projects.name: Joyride
projects.notes: ClojureScript scripting environment with access to the VS Code API.

projects.name: Lumo
projects.notes: Standalone self-hosted ClojureScript environment; older toolchain.

projects.name: nbb
projects.notes: ClojureScript scripting runtime using SCI.

projects.name: obb
projects.notes: ClojureScript automation of Mac applications via osascript.

projects.name: Planck
projects.notes: Standalone ClojureScript REPL and scripting runtime.

projects.name: Scittle
projects.notes: SCI exposed through script tags.

projects.name: uclj
projects.notes: Alternative native Clojure interpreter using JVM Clojure runtime components.

projects.name: YAMLScript
projects.notes: YS / YAMLScript: alternate YAML syntax compiling to Clojure; count host bindings as integrations.

projects.name: Apricot
projects.notes: Independent Clojure-inspired Lisp compiled to Rubinius bytecode.

projects.name: Bars
projects.notes: Independent systems language with Clojure syntax and ownership semantics.

projects.name: Beagle
projects.notes: Author explicitly calls it an independent statically typed Lisp derived from Clojure.

projects.name: Bridje
projects.notes: Independent statically typed language; current design includes C/Java-style surface syntax.

projects.name: Carbonate
projects.notes: Independent Lisp transpiling to Ruby, heavily influenced by Clojure.

projects.name: Carp
projects.notes: Independent statically typed Lisp with ownership tracking.

projects.name: Charon
projects.notes: Independent functional Lisp transpiler; alpha.

projects.name: CljPerl
projects.notes: CljPerl: Clojure-inspired Lisp with Perl and CPAN interop.

projects.name: Clojette
projects.notes: Independent Clojure-like language; requires game environment for intended use.

projects.name: Closhure
projects.notes: Embedded Lisp with Clojure-like syntax; distinct from ClojureCLR and Clarp.

projects.name: Convex Lisp
projects.notes: Clojure-related smart-contract language; separate runtime and semantics.

projects.name: Crisp
projects.notes: Independent Lisp based on MAL.

projects.name: Fennel
projects.notes: Independent Lua Lisp; distinct from ClojureFnl.

projects.name: Fleck
projects.notes: Clojure-like Lisp for Bash; author no longer actively developing it.

projects.name: Frock
projects.notes: Clojure-flavoured PHP transpiler; separate from Phel.

projects.name: gherkin
projects.notes: Independent functional Lisp; explicitly dormant.

projects.name: Glisp
projects.notes: Custom Lisp inside a graphical design environment.

projects.name: HC-Lisp
projects.notes: Educational Clojure/Norvig-inspired Lisp; explicitly experimental.

projects.name: Hy
projects.notes: Independent Lisp embedded in Python; Python AST semantics.

projects.name: Janet
projects.notes: Independent scripting and embeddable Lisp.

projects.name: Javelin
projects.notes: kimtg/Javelin: embedded Lisp with Clojure-like syntax; not Hoplon's Javelin library.

projects.name: Joxa
projects.notes: Independent Lisp; README explicitly distinguishes it from Clojure.

projects.name: Kapok
projects.notes: Independent Lisp with Clojure-like syntax.

projects.name: ki
projects.notes: Lisp with Clojure-like semantics and Mori collections embedded in JavaScript.

projects.name: Lemma
projects.notes: Independent Lisp influenced by Scheme, Arc and Clojure.

projects.name: Lispery
projects.notes: Embedded Lisp influenced by Schemy and Clojure; project description verified.

projects.name: llr
projects.notes: Small Clojure-inspired Lisp implemented in and compiling to R.

projects.name: Lux
projects.notes: Independent statically typed language; Clojure is a syntax influence.

projects.name: Magic
projects.notes: Independent experimental typed Lisp influenced by Clojure.

projects.name: mal
projects.notes: Educational Make-a-Lisp language; count the language once, track its many implementations separately.

projects.name: malc
projects.notes: Compiler implementation of MAL; not another Clojure dialect.

projects.name: miniMAL
projects.notes: Independent small Lisp derived from MAL with different syntax.

projects.name: Phel
projects.notes: Closely related language commonly included in dialect lists; own language and PHP compiler.

projects.name: Piglet
projects.notes: Piglet explicitly says it is a different language, not a Clojure implementation.

projects.name: Pixie
projects.notes: Clojure-inspired language with its own runtime and standard library.

projects.name: Purisp
projects.notes: Small Lisp project; README documents REPL build, lineage less fully documented.

projects.name: Rhine
projects.notes: Independent Clojure-inspired Lisp compiler.

projects.name: Risp
projects.notes: Small configuration Lisp; author describes it as an approximate Clojure subset.

projects.name: RubyLisp
projects.notes: Independent Lisp exposing Ruby's facilities.

projects.name: Rusjure
projects.notes: Independent compiler and language highly inspired by Clojure.

projects.name: Sheaf
projects.notes: Independent Clojure-inspired tensor and machine-learning language.

projects.name: SLisp
projects.notes: Independent experimental Lisp drawing on Clojure and other languages.

projects.name: Toccata
projects.notes: Independent Clojure-inspired Lisp compiling to native executables.

projects.name: Venice
projects.notes: Independent Clojure-inspired sandboxed scripting Lisp.

projects.name: wisp
projects.notes: Clojure-like Lisp with native JavaScript values and compilation.

projects.name: zygomys
projects.notes: Zygo / Zygomys: independent embeddable Lisp borrowing Clojure syntax.

projects.name: LispSyntax.jl
projects.notes: Syntax translator to Julia AST; README explicitly says it is not a Clojure implementation.

projects.name: Lithium
projects.notes: Assembler written in Clojure plus toy Lisp compiler; not evidence of Clojure implementation.

projects.name: Liz
projects.notes: S-expression frontend; author explicitly says it lacks features needed to be a Clojure dialect.

projects.name: Scriptjure
projects.notes: Library generating JavaScript strings from forms; not a standalone Clojure runtime.

projects.name: Clarp
projects.notes: Runtime code and tests exist; no documented evaluator or hello-world entry point established.

projects.name: clojure-metal
projects.notes: README remains a generated placeholder; no runnable implementation established.

projects.name: ClojureScript (Chris Houser early attempt)
projects.notes: Official 2011 announcement acknowledges an earlier, distinct JavaScript implementation; source/build not located in this review.

projects.name: ClojureSwift
projects.notes: Repository contains proposal/literature review and license; no implementation established.
